title: Model Registry & Market Drift Resilience Evaluation

scenarios.description: Nominal October 2026 commercial pricing and capability parameters
50% price reduction on Tier C (Gemini Flash price cut)
35% price increase on Tier D frontier models
2.5x provider latency degradation on Tier C (provider congestion)
Small model generational update brings quality prior to 0.89 near-parity
Deprecate legacy model ID and redirect to next-generation endpoint
scenarios.action: Seamless routing migration with zero caller reconfiguration

conclusion: The InferPath candidate selection framework automatically absorbs pricing shocks, latency fluctuations, and generational model leaps through parameterized objective rebalancing without requiring code refactoring.
